subject: Post-incident privacy clearance and telemetry synthesis for Orion Financials
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@orionfin.com>, security@orionfin.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial telemetry summary and next steps (Orion incident follow-up)

Hi Jane / Orion security team,

Following our call this morning I wanted to share a concise summary of the checks we ran on the telemetry and access logs after the outage window (2026-11-28 03:00–03:40 UTC). Our initial automated scans looked for anomalous outbound transfers, abnormal read patterns of customer keys, and long-running streaming sessions tied to Orion tenant IDs. High-level results:

- No outbound transfers to external S3 endpoints from any Orion tenant compute observed in the window.
- No access tokens were used outside of expected regions.
- KV-cache inspection shows no customer keys touched by non-Redwood processes.

We are packaging the artifacts (summary CSV, per-shard hash list, and our post-incident statement) and will share them as attachments and via the Drive folder linked below. Please let us know any additional slices you want us to extract (user-level, session-level, or IP-level).

Next steps we propose:
- Deliver full log summary and hashes by EOD PST today (attached).
- Provide a short walk-through with our SREs and your security reviewers tomorrow (propose 10:00 AM PST).

I’m copying Laura and Dylan who coordinated the log harvest.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Security Ops Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: telemetry_snapshot_20261129.csv (CSV), log_summary_telemetry_hashes.txt (text)
From: Jane Park <jane.park@orionfin.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@orionfin.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Initial telemetry summary and next steps (Orion incident follow-up)

Marcus —

Appreciate the quick summary. A couple of asks from our side: 

1) Can you include the SHA256 hashes for the log files you collected and the exact UTC time ranges used for each shard? We need those for our internal chain-of-custody when we present to our audit team.
2) Please confirm whether any service account credentials were rotated as part of the mitigation and, if so, which ones.

We can do the walkthrough tomorrow at 10:00 AM PST. Please include your SRE and the person who authored the log-collection script.

–Jane
Jane Park
Director, Information Security
Orion Financials
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@orionfin.com>, security@orionfin.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 07:29:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial telemetry summary and next steps (Orion incident follow-up)

Jane —

Thanks — attaching the artifacts you requested and answering inline: 

1) SHA256 hashes are in log_summary_telemetry_hashes.txt (attached) and in the Drive folder. The harvest included three log shards covering these UTC ranges: 2026-11-28T03:00:00Z–2026-11-28T03:40:00Z (primary), 2026-11-28T03:40:01Z–2026-11-28T04:10:00Z (post-window sampling), and 2026-11-28T00:00:00Z–2026-11-28T06:00:00Z (extended context). Each file has a matching SHA256 and file-size entry in the summary.

2) We rotated the ephemeral SRE deployment keys used for the cluster control plane at 2026-11-28T05:10:22Z UTC as a precaution. No customer keys or KMS material were rotated because none were accessed.

Confirmations: 
- No customer data exfiltration detected across the window. Our detection queries (listed in the summary) matched zero external-transfer events and zero unauthorized read events for tenant IDs tied to Orion.
- All changes made for mitigation were limited to Redwood operational credentials and deployment artifacts.

We’ll run through the artifacts and the collection script at 10:00 AM PST; Dylan will present the log-parsing steps and Laura will speak to evidence packaging and the chain-of-custody records.

Regards,
Marcus

Attachments: redwood_postincident_statement.pdf (PDF)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal — wording check for customer-facing statement

Marcus / Dylan —

Quick note before the 10:00 walkthrough: Orion asked for a crisp sentence they can share with their compliance team that clearly states our findings. I suggest: 

"Redwood Inference confirmed no customer data exfiltration or unauthorized access to Orion Financials tenant data during the incident window; audit-grade logs and SHA256 hashes have been provided for independent verification."

Two asks: (1) can we reference the exact artifact names in the external statement (we have the attachments ready), and (2) confirm Rishi signs the internal chain-of-custody record after he verifies the hashes.

If you’re good with that wording I’ll include it in the post-incident PDF.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@orionfin.com>, security@orionfin.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Final confirmation and evidence package (Orion Financials)

Jane / Orion team —

Thank you for the meeting earlier. Per our walkthrough, this is the formal confirmation and the evidence package we delivered: 

Summary statement (for your records and audit use):
"Redwood Inference confirms that, following exhaustive log analysis for the incident window 2026-11-28T03:00:00Z to 2026-11-28T03:40:00Z, there is no evidence of customer data exfiltration or unauthorized access to Orion Financials tenant data. Audit-grade logs, file sizes, and SHA256 hashes have been provided for independent verification (see attached artifacts)."

Artifacts delivered (attached and in Drive):
- telemetry_snapshot_20261129.csv — session-level sample (CSV)
- log_summary_telemetry_hashes.txt — per-file SHA256 and timestamps
- redwood_postincident_statement.pdf — formatted statement and chain-of-custody checklist

Operational notes:
- Rotated ephemeral SRE deployment keys at 2026-11-28T05:10:22Z UTC; no customer KMS keys were rotated nor accessed.
- Collected shards cover 2026-11-28T00:00:00Z–2026-11-28T06:00:00Z for extended context; primary window as above.

If you need notarized records or an export in a different format for your auditor, we can provide that. Rishi will sign the internal chain-of-custody and confirm hash verification by EOD.

Appreciate your partnership while we closed this out.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Security Ops Engineer
Redwood Inference

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OrionPostIncidentPack
Jira: SEC-4821
Attachments: telemetry_snapshot_20261129.csv, log_summary_telemetry_hashes.txt, redwood_postincident_statement.pdf
